method: Global same-power connected components, complete 480-point integer-temperature RMS <= 0.01 C; block-average KD-tree candidates verified on full curves
pilot_protection: All original test rows stay test. Components prioritize test then validation. Previously explored pilot rows in conflicting heldout components are set aside, not relabeled as unseen test data.
limits: Connected components can contain distant curves through chains; these are not physical building IDs.
Same heating protocol with different responses can occur in different partitions.
Protected cohorts and large components can prevent exact 80/10/10 ratios or balanced zero-power counts.
